summary: cloud.terraform needs your own execution environment containing the latest cloud.terraform and the terraform CLI binary; the default AAP EE lacks the binary. Add it under Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Execution Environments > Create execution environment with a name and image link. Community-edition EEs can be reused after updating.
questions: Why can't I use the default execution environment with cloud.terraform?
How do I add a Terraform execution environment to AAP?
Does the cloud.terraform EE need the terraform binary?
